## Message

```
[X18N5005] Not an open suggestion <detail>
├▶ fix: Apply only open reviews of type `suggestion`.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n5005
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

`x18n review apply-suggestion` applies only reviews of type `suggestion` that are not resolved yet.

1. Run `x18n review list --open` to list open suggestions.
2. To change the value yourself, use `x18n set`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
